text: Please I have been waiting since on this line and nobody is responding, this is not fair at all. My daughter Aisha is 3 years old. Since yesterday she is having catarrh, her nose is running and sometimes blocking and she is sneezing up and down. That one I can manage. But wallahi something is not right. Her nappy have been dry since morning, I changed her by 9am and since then till now nothing, not even small wee, it is more than 12 hours now. Then her crying has changed, it is not her normal cry at all. It is a thin high voice like a whistle and she will just keep crying and crying non stop, I carry her, I pat her, nothing is working. My daughter is not like this, when she cry she cry loud then she stop. I have been calling and texting and nobody is replying me. Abeg I need somebody to tell me what to do now, inshaAllah someone will see this message.
